items.proposed: no selection biomarker (MGMT is not eligibility or enrichment)
items.reason: MGMT status decides only whether the temozolomide backbone is given ('TMZ will be omitted in MGMT unmethylated patients'); it is not an entry requirement and no registered arm or cohort requires it, so it is not enrichment. Code it exploratory_correlative (as coder A); in any case MGMT is never candidate-matched here.

regimen counts all antitumour therapy in the experimental arms; both arms receive nivolumab, relatlimab, RT and TMZ ('receive RT and temozolomide (TMZ) ... in combination with nivolumab and relatlimab'), and both antibodies are candidates, so each is the other's partner.

note: IDH-wildtype is stated in the brief summary only (diagnostic, excluded from any_molecular_selection). The combination_partners convention (whether co-candidates are listed as partners) should be applied the same way across the queue.
